asked.item: Ask Claude via Blotato MCP to search Inspiration database for viral posts
Doing it the way as in the web app

verdict.reason: S8 states the MCP tool catalog has no Inspiration Database search tool, and the tutorial describes the web app search.

steps.text: The MCP tool catalog does not expose an Inspiration Database search tool.
To search Inspiration, open the navigation menu in the web app, expand Tools, select Inspiration, and use Search posts... to enter a topic.
